title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish that's perfect for grilling. Marinated lamb kebabs are cooked to perfection and served with a side of flavorful spices.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Saudi Arabian spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
